overall: The AG found no violation by the Cape Cod Commission or its Executive Committee on any allegation: notices were properly posted, materials and remote access claims were not required or not shown to be failures, and no executive session was convened.

allegations.summary: Commission allegedly failed to confirm physical posting of its August 14 meeting notice and filing with county officials.
allegations.key_passage: Where the notices at issue were properly posted to the Commission and Committee’s official notice posting location, we find no violation.

allegations.summary: Commission's notice topic on the Executive Director's report was allegedly too vague.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Committee did not reach the topic of the Executive Director’s report and because the Commission did not discuss any aspect of the Executive Director’s report in any way, we find no violation with respect to the notice topic concerning the Executive Director’s report.

allegations.key_passage: Because the Commission and Committee were not required, under the Open Meeting Law, to provide copies of documents to the public before or during the August 14 meetings, we find no violation.
